meaning:
ὑδρία, -ας, ἠ
(ὕδωρ), [in LXX for בַּד ;]
1. prop., a water-pot or jar: Jhn.2:6, 7 John 4:28.
2. More frequently in Attic = ἄγγυς, a pot, urn or jar of any kind, as for holding wine, coins, etc. (see Rutherford, NPhr., 23; MM, xxv).
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
